The first official release of InkShelf: a library for the books on your Supernote, in the spirit of NovelUpdates and Mihon.

**Download `InkShelf.snplg` below.** Copy it to the **MyStyle** folder on your Supernote, then **Settings › Apps › Plugins › Add Plugin**. Open any book or note and tap the InkShelf button in the toolbar. To update later, install the newer file the same way: it replaces the old one and keeps everything.

### Highlights
- Libraries from any folders (Supernote or SD card). Subfolders become categories, and `Vol / Part / Chapter` files join into one book.
- Book pages with **Start / Continue**, reading status with dates, and sticky notes with your 1–5 star ratings.
- Filter by genre, tag, author or content warnings, and sort by title, last read, added, author or rating. Arrows instead of scrolling.
- Collections with rules, a wishlist, and paper books with lending.
- Profile: books finished per month, an optional yearly goal, time spent reading, reading days, top genres, and a searchable board of every note.
- Fills empty details from the EPUB or from Calibre's `metadata.opf` and `cover.jpg`.
- Fill in many books on a computer with `InkShelf books.xlsx` (drop-down lists). Import from or export to Goodreads and StoryGraph.
- Automatic backup in `Document/InkShelf`, restored by itself after reinstalling.

### Privacy
No internet, no accounts, no tracking. InkShelf only reads your books (it never changes or deletes them) and keeps its own data on the device. Details are in the README.

Built and tested on a Supernote Nomad. Made by vibe-coding with Claude. The walkthrough video below uses made-up demo books.
